content.description:
CardanoDraw is a ticket based raffle system.

Get some tickets for a chance to win the ADA jackpot. Your tickets live on the blockchain as tokens, with unique tokens for every edition. The winning ticket is selected randomly using the Random.org engine, after which the prize is transferred to the address used to purchase the winning ticket!
